messages.subject: Transformation crash?
parts:
Hi all,

Tried to standardize a variable PMC in a data set but this pops up error message?

This was working a week or so ago.

Transformation Error on standardizing?  If I use Log to standardize that works.

descriptive.table(vars = d(PMC),data= Emball_PMC,
+ func.names =c("Mean","St. Deviation","Valid N"))
$`strata: all cases `
         Mean.PMC St. Deviation.PMC       Valid N.PMC
         1.537173          1.362698         11.000000

> Emball_PMC[['PMC.tr']] <- rescaler(Emball_PMC[['PMC']])
Error: could not find function "rescaler"

Bruce
--

ian
